purpose: Authoritative status of the controlled property fixture admission gate.

blocking_reason.description: No corrected or replacement controlled fixture has been admitted and approved for dependent revalidation.

status_rules: PASSED gate validation does not mean the admission gate is open.
A gate may be structurally valid while operationally blocked.
Approval requires the admission conditions to be satisfied.
No dependent revalidation may execute while execution_allowed is false.
A source-derived fixture remains a controlled fixture and does not automatically become production evidence.
guardrails: No live official property record is claimed.
